extracted.name: Lo Mein Noodles
extracted.description: These lo mein noodles feature spaghetti and crisp vegetables flavored with soy sauce, teriyaki, honey, and ginger for a quick and easy weeknight dish.
ingredient_lines: 2 large carrots, cut into large matchsticks
instruction_lines: Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil. Cook spaghetti in boiling water, stirring occasionally, until tender yet firm to the bite, about 12 minutes; drain, then rinse with cold water to cool.
Meanwhile, whisk soy sauce, teriyaki sauce, honey, and ginger together in a small bowl; set aside.
While the spaghetti cooks, heat oil in a large skillet or wok over high heat. Cook and stir celery, carrots, onion, and green onions until slightly tender, 5 to 7 minutes.
Add spaghetti and soy sauce mixture. Cook, stirring frequently, until heated through and evenly coated, about 2 to 3 minutes. Serve garnished with additional sliced green onions, if desired.
